institutions.name: Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences (HvA / AUAS)
institutions.entity_note: Official overview is JavaScript-rendered so count compiled from faculty pages, sitemap and programme pages. Excluded: part-time/dual IB, European MSc Occupational Therapy (2-year part-time), Dutch-taught programmes; Applied AI master and Structural Engineering master not verified as English full-time. Institutional fee 2026-27 EUR 10,648 per central page (IB page shows EUR 10,684). Master degree prefixes (MSc/MA) for some programmes inferred.

programs.name: BBA International Business (AMSIB)
programs.requirements_note: Non-EU applicants need a secondary diploma comparable to Dutch HAVO/VWO/MBO-4 (credential evaluation by AUAS; Nuffic comparison). No Turkey-specific rule published (Turkish Lise Diploması is assessed individually). HAVO/VWO equivalent with Mathematics or Economics; non-EU applicants must complete a questionnaire and may be interviewed; English B2 required (IELTS 6.0 with no subscore below 5.5; TOEFL iBT 80, subscores 20).

programs.name: BBA International Business Fast Track (AMSIB)
programs.requirements_note: Fast-track version of AMSIB International Business for strong students: VWO-equivalent level required (listed as a separate programme by AUAS); otherwise same non-EU questionnaire/interview and English rules (IELTS 6.0, no subscore below 5.5; TOEFL iBT 80). Turkey-specific rules not published; diploma evaluated individually.

programs.name: BA Fashion & Textile Technologies (AMFI)
programs.application_deadline: 15 January 2027 (numerus fixus selection; enrolment 1 Oct 2026 - 15 Jan 2027)
programs.requirements_note: Limited places (quota 440) with selection based on portfolio, assignment and video; HAVO/VWO/MBO-4 equivalent diploma; IELTS 6.0 (no subscore below 5.5) or TOEFL iBT 80. Specialisations Fashion & Management, Branding, Design. Turkey-specific rules not published; Nuffic/AUAS credential evaluation applies. Degree prefix (BA) not stated on page - verify against CROHO.

programs.name: BSc Physiotherapy (European School of Physiotherapy)
programs.requirements_note: Honours-style 3-year, English-taught full-time programme with selection (100 places); proof of English IELTS 6.5 or equivalent; secondary diploma comparable to VWO/HAVO with required subjects; higher institutional fee EUR 11,648 (statutory EUR 3,694). Turkey-specific rules not published. Degree prefix (BSc) to verify against CROHO.

programs.name: BSc Sport Studies - International Sports Management and Business (ISMB)
programs.application_deadline: 15 January 2027 (numerus fixus selection; 96 places for ISMB track)
programs.requirements_note: English-taught ISMB track of Sport Studies; HAVO/VWO/MBO-4 equivalent diploma plus selection procedure (quota); IELTS 6.0 (no subscore below 6.0), TOEFL iBT 80. Turkey-specific rules not published. Listed by AUAS as 'Sport Studies (English)'; degree prefix to verify.

programs.name: MSc Digital Design - Interaction Design
programs.requirements_note: Bachelor degree plus annotated design portfolio; ideally 3 years' design work experience; selection procedure; IELTS Academic or TOEFL required (minimum score not captured). Turkish bachelor degrees assessed individually (Nuffic).

programs.name: MSc Digital Design - Digital Fashion Technology
programs.requirements_note: Bachelor degree (or equivalent) plus portfolio showing IT, fashion or design experience; selection; IELTS Academic or TOEFL required (minimum score not captured). Listed by AUAS as separate programme page from Interaction Design.

programs.name: MSc Digital Driven Business
programs.requirements_note: Follow-on master: bachelor in business/economics, engineering, ICT or technology with affinity to the other domains; selection procedure; IELTS 6.5 overall with minimum 6.0 per section (TOEFL also accepted).

programs.name: MSc Global Sustainable Business Management
programs.requirements_note: Non-funded master: fee EUR 17,083 is the total for the full 18-month programme (AUAS central page lists a different older figure EUR 16,610). Bachelor degree required; IELTS Academic 7.0 overall (TOEFL also accepted).

programs.name: MSc Sport Business & Leadership
programs.requirements_note: For professionals: bachelor degree plus work experience in sport organisations; selection procedure with max 60 students; IELTS Academic 7.0 (Cambridge CAE/CPE also accepted).

programs.name: MSc Applied Quantum Technology
programs.requirements_note: Joint degree of four Dutch UAS; bachelor in a relevant technical field with aptitude in mathematics/physics/programming; selection procedure; IELTS 6.5 (subscore 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 86 (old scale, minimum 20 per section). Duration (2 years, second year internship) inferred from page text - verify.

institutions.name: HU University of Applied Sciences Utrecht
institutions.entity_note: Counted from sitemap/programme pages of internationalhu.com (programme list is JS). Excluded part-time Teacher Education in English variants (bachelor and master) and Teacher Education in French/German/Spanish (taught in target languages). Institutional fee 2026-27 EUR 10,747.

programs.name: BBA International Business
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Non-EU: diploma comparable to Dutch HAVO (Nuffic list), intake procedure (digital assessment plus interview); IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 80 (C1 Advanced also accepted). Turkey-specific rules not published (assessed individually). Studielink deadline 31 May for non-EU applicants who need HU immigration services (1 Aug for others living abroad).

programs.name: BBA International Business FastTrack
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Three-year accelerated programme with its own application (motivation letter, CV, two referees, diploma and grade list to the FastTrack office). Listed on a separate HU page (fasttrack). General non-EU rules as for International Business (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80).

programs.name: BA Creative Business
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Non-EU: diploma comparable to Dutch HAVO (Nuffic list), intake procedure (digital assessment plus interview); IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 80 (C1 Advanced also accepted). Turkey-specific rules not published (assessed individually). Studielink deadline 31 May for non-EU applicants who need HU immigration services (1 Aug for others living abroad).

programs.name: BEd Teacher Education in English
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Trains English teachers (Bachelor of Education); requires English CEFR B2, diploma evaluation, programme selection check and possibly an interview; IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 stated. Check whether Dutch-language components apply to non-EU students. Turkey-specific rules not published.

programs.name: MA Data-driven Design
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Bachelor in CMD, Creative Business, Journalism, Communication, International Business, ICT or similar; coding assignment, English motivation letter and matching; IELTS Academic 6.5 (no subscore below 6.0); TOEFL iBT 5.0 on new 1-6 scale (sub 4.5). Fee per general HU institutional fee (programme page directs to fee calculator).

programs.name: MSc Next Level Engineering
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Bachelor in a technical domain; analytical test, motivation assignment and intake interview; IELTS 6.5 (no subscore below 6.0). Fee per general HU institutional fee (programme page directs to calculator).

programs.name: MSc Sustainable Business Transition
programs.application_deadline: 31 May (non-EU requiring HU visa services); 2027 intake
programs.requirements_note: Bachelor in the economic domain (or 60 credits in business subjects); English motivation letter, self-assessment and matching interview; IELTS 6.5 (no subscore below 6.0). Fee per general HU institutional fee (calculator).

institutions.name: Leiden University of Applied Sciences (Hogeschool Leiden)
institutions.entity_note: hsleiden.nl is behind a bot challenge (HTTP 403), so facts come from search snippets of official pages and could not be directly verified. All bachelor programmes are Dutch-taught; part-time Digital Forensics excluded. Fee shown is the 2026-27 institutional fee quoted by the official page.

programs.name: MSc Digital Forensics (full-time)
programs.requirements_note: Direct entry: Leiden UAS ICT bachelor (Forensic IT) or CS/ICT/informatics bachelor plus the Leiden UAS 'Digital Forensics' minor; other ICT bachelors may need a pre-master; academic English proof IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / PTE 61. Classes at HSD Campus The Hague. Data from search-engine snippets of hsleiden.nl (site blocked for direct fetch).

programs.name: BBA International Business

Windesheim's accepted-diploma list includes the Turkish Lise Diploması and Teknik Lise Diploması; no YKS or foundation-year rule published. Institutional fee 2027-2028 approx EUR 9,580.
